biggest_catch: Election Day shift runs 6am to ~8:30pm (14.5 hours) plus ~2 hours of setup the day before, for a lump sum of $275-$390.
catches: Election-period work only; Election Day is a ~14.5-hour shift plus ~2 hours setup the prior day.

Early-voting workers must be available the entire Oct 15-31 period (six days a week).
Student assistants (17+) earn the $275 base tier.

notes: Early-voting roles: $15-$17/hr for 7+ hour shifts Oct 15-31; full-time seasonal office positions also listed; MAT (Multi-partisan Assistance Team) positions mostly filled for this cycle.

payout_quote: Nearly 500 election day poll workers support the Nov. 3 election at 80 precincts across the county. Training is required in advance. Workers assist with polling place setup on Nov. 2 for approximately two hours, then return on Election Day for a full shift from 6 a.m. until approximately 8:30 p.m. Pay is a lump sum, ranging from $275 to $390 depending on the role.
payout_value_note: Official lump-sum Election Day pay by role ($275-$390).

steps: Fill out the poll worker application online, call 828-250-4200, or visit buncombenc.gov Employment and Poll Worker Opportunities.
Attend mandatory advance training for the assigned role.
Assist with polling-place setup on Nov 2 (~2 hours).
Work the full Election Day shift, 6am to ~8:30pm.
timing: Nov 3, 2026 Election Day (setup Nov 2); early voting Oct 15-31; training in advance.
